SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No.
S.M.P. S. I. R. Station,
No. S. B. D. 1795.
Date Oct 27 1930
at 4 - 11 - 30.

Subject (in full) application from Public Safety Bureau
for services of Policemen

Made by Supt Tan Shaohiang Forwarded by

Mrs. Wang Kwang Sun on behalf
of Col Yuan Liang rang up this morning
applying for services of 2 or 3
policemen for duty outside the
Majesty Hotel between 2 & 4
p.m. this date when the Mayor
will entertain a number of prominent
foreign and Chinese officials and
merchants.

Tan Shaohiang
Supt.

报告

档案编号
上海公共租界工部局特别情报股（S.M.P. S. I. R.）分局，
编号 S. B. D. 1795。
日期 1930年10月27日
于 4 - 11 - 30。

主题（全称）公安局申请派遣警员

由谭绍祥督察提交 转呈者

王光孙夫人代表袁良上校今晨致电，
申请在今日下午2时至4时期间，
派遣2至3名警员在华懋饭店（Majesty Hotel）外执勤，
届时市长将宴请多位中外知名官员及商人。

谭绍祥
督察
